en-GB.Select the centre the pattern turns arou: Select the centre the pattern turns around first
en-GB.Snap to face and edge centres: Snap to face and edge centres
en-GB.help.appearance.assign: Gives the selected bodies, faces or components a colour or a material look, without changing their weight. Use it to tell parts apart or to preview a finish.
en-GB.help.face.delete: Removes the selected faces and lets the neighbouring faces close the gap, or leaves the gap open as a surface. Use it to take off a rounded edge, a hole or a boss that is in the way.
en-GB.help.font_details: The interface uses egui's built-in fonts (Ubuntu Light and Hack, under the Ubuntu Font Licence and the MIT/Bitstream Vera licence; Noto Emoji and the emoji icon font, under the OFL and MIT). Sketch text uses Liberation Sans (SIL OFL 1.1). The Crafting Apps' optional font pack, craft-fonts (BIZ UDPGothic, Shippori Mincho, BIZ UDMincho, Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans Arabic; SIL OFL 1.1), is not bundled in SolidCraft builds.
en-GB.help.material.assign: Sets what the selected bodies are made of, such as steel, aluminium or ABS. Use it so that the mass and weight match the real part.
en-GB.help.solid.draft: Tilts the selected faces by the angle you set, measured from a neutral plane. Use it on moulded or cast parts so that they slide out of the mould.
en-GB.help.solid.revolve: Spins a sketch profile around an axis to make a round solid. Use it for shafts, knobs, bowls and any part that is round about a centre line.
en-GB.help.solid.split_body: Cuts a body into separate bodies with a plane, the face of another body or a sketch line. Use it to make parts that are printed, machined or coloured on their own.
en-GB.help.solid.split_face: Divides the selected faces along a plane, the face of another body or sketch curves, without cutting the body. Use it to give part of a face its own draft, colour or offset.
en-GB.navbar.description.separator: A thin line that groups neighbouring slots.
en-GB.prefs.trackpad_zoom_modifier.help: Hold only this key to zoom at the pointer with vertical scroll. Off keeps the existing scroll behaviour.
en-GB.render.cpu_area_editor_help: Full side vectors in millimeters; U cross V points towards the emitting side. This differs from GPU half-edge vectors.
en-GB.render.environment.radial_only: Centre and radius apply to Radial mode.
en-GB.render.error_finish_gesture: finish the modelling gesture before previewing
en-GB.render.error_finish_operation: finish the current modelling operation before entering Render
en-GB.render.image_scene_stale: Finish the modelling gesture or refresh the scene before checking or starting an image.
en-GB.render.light_preview_help: Live view is unshadowed; Area lights use a centre-sample approximation. Render uses the complete light model.
en-GB.render.ribbon_studios_help: Browse implemented studio compositions and review their replacements before applying. Concept-only scenes remain labelled.
en-GB.render.stage_panels.source_note: Authored base-colour source map. Not a measured material.
en-GB.render.studio_area_help: Up to four one-sided rectangles. Orthogonal half-edges U and V define size; U × V faces the lit side. Coordinates are world-space millimetres.
en-GB.ui.3d_mouse_orbit_tip: Traced: the 3D mouse turns the view around the part of the model in the middle of the view when the turn begins, marked by a faint ball. Classic: around the view's centre
en-GB.ui.ai_mode_edits_note: Modelling commands run without asking; saving, opening, exporting and other file or destructive actions still ask.
en-GB.ui.colour_vision_note: Changes the colours that carry a meaning: sketch states, axes, bends, analyses and icons. If you use Windows colour filters, keep this Off.
en-GB.ui.export_keymap_tip: Keys, S box favourites and the toolbar, as a file
en-GB.ui.material_review.claims: Sources and licences are unverified claims. Missing values remain unknown.
